provenance: Prepared in the interactive Codex development session, 2026-10-17. These notes are not Unity Gateway output or an assertion of human approval.

architecture.proposal: Use a bounded complete-feed Delta snapshot and triggered serverless SDP materialized views for Bronze, quarantine, Silver and Gold customer history.
assumptions: Full UPSERT images and all historical events are available on every refresh.
A positive customer sequence uniquely orders strictly increasing UTC event timestamps.
Reject ambiguous event identity, sequence and timestamp conflicts before replacing input data.
Quarantined rows may leave incomplete history and require review.
questions: Is complete-feed batch recomputation sufficient for the course MVP?
Should invalid events block publication in a later version?

implementation.decision: Generate the supported pattern from versioned templates and share Spark transformation functions with the workspace verifier.
details: Deduplicate validated event IDs in Silver.
Filter unchanged UPSERTs before computing history intervals.
Compute lead timestamps before filtering DELETE events so deleted rows close correctly.
A reinsert after DELETE starts a new version even if attributes match a previous version.

unit_testing.decision: Use hand-authored independent expected intervals and boundary cases. Execute generated pytest tests separately from recording their generated status.

integration_review.decision: Verify actual Spark transformations and deployed tables against the independent four-row history fixture, including duplicate replay and reversed arrival.
limitations: Generated scenarios are not execution evidence
